caption: The load offset creates a primary moment; the deflection it causes adds a second moment, and the secant factor multiplies the primary moment until it becomes infinite at the Euler load. In the worked example P = 8 kN, P<sub>E</sub> = 13.8 kN, e = 2 mm and the peak stress is 61.8 MPa.

spec.title: How an eccentricity feeds itself
spec.aria: A flow that starts with an off-centre load, produces a primary moment, causes a deflection, and feeds a second moment back into that deflection until the secant formula gives the peak stress.
